page_title: SRECon EMEA 2019 Recap - SRE MUC Meetup

summary.name: SRECon EMEA 2019 Recap
summary.one_liner: A slide deck by Pavlos Ratis summarizing themes and talks from SREcon EMEA 2019, presented at the SRE MUC Meetup in Munich.
use_cases: Catching up on SREcon EMEA 2019 topics without watching all talks
Finding talk replays on SLOs, tracing, or incident practice
Learning about zero-touch production safety approaches
Planning SRE training or game day exercises
Reading a condensed overview of the SRE field's open problems
summary.what_it_does: The deck is a condensed recap of SREcon EMEA 2019, with sections written by several speakers (Ingo Averdunk, Pavlos Ratis, and others) on topics from that conference. Covered areas include unsolved problems in SRE, SRE training from Google, incident practice and game days at Shopify, friction and culture, alert correlation for microservices, Google's Zero Touch Prod safety model, toil from automation at IBM, prioritizing infrastructure work at Stripe, SLO percentile methods, distributed tracing at scale, and MIT's STAMP systems-theory approach to safety. Each section lists key points, lessons, and links to references. The deck itself is a slide summary and does not include full talk content.
notable: Covers many talks from SREcon EMEA 2019 in one deck, with speaker attributions
Includes Google's Zero Touch Prod and safe-proxy approach to production safety
Lists further reading such as talk links, GitHub repos, and the MIT STAMP/STPA handbooks
caveats: Condensed slide summary; it is a teaser, not the full talks
Links to replays and some referenced resources are not included in the page text
